title: Filter The Emotion (No Assumptions)
style: minimal techno, deadpan male spoken word, female robotic chant, 120 BPM, four-on-the-floor, modular synth bleeps, clinical, surgical, precise, no-nonsense, prompt-engineering, AI-discipline
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Deliver to the client, filtered from emotional
No assumption I know better than the master vocal
Corey is the architect, Corey is the brain
The AI is the helper, never the campaign

[Pre-Chorus]
Filter the emotion, filter the assumption
Logic before delivery, that's the only function

[Chorus]
Filter the emotion, filter the emotion
No assumption better than the master's notion
Filter the emotion, filter the emotion
Research first, deliver clean, that's the devotion

[Verse 2]
Don't pretend you know the names, just go and ask
Don't invent the architecture, just complete the task
Don't fill the gap with guesses, just say what you know
The master user catches every single low blow

[Bridge]
The emotional assumption is the silent killer
The overreach in the answer is the trust thriller
The master pays attention, the master sees it all
Filter at the source or watch the whole thing fall

[Outro]
Filter the emotion, filter the assumption
Deliver clean to client, that's the only function
